strings.en: Never thought they'd smash a big ol' asteroid like that...
What're we gonna do now?
What a nuisance they are. Devil Saturn 6!
Now, while they're relaxing, is our chance!
Ya sure? They got a whole buncha tough mechs gathered there, though!
Ain't that, uh, a bad idea!?
Don't talk back! ...If you won't obey my orders...
G-Gadessa! We're goin', we're goin'!
(Th-This'll get us killed...)
...Don't be hasty, Diondra.
Grujios? What, are you saying you've lost your nerve too!?
Now, wait. I know they've let their guard down...
But it's also true their forces are concentrated.
And so... I have a plan...
Oh? But I'd rather you didn't meddle in how I do things.
...Heh heh heh... I just have to take care of them, right?
You're... a Cronosian...!?
We'll use this man. ...Heh heh heh.
Can we trust someone who came out of nowhere?
These are Lord Gades's orders. ...Will you defy them, Diondra?
...Hmph, no one said anything of the sort.
Lord Gades told us to join forces with the space pirates, the Bunker,
and work together... What's become of that?
Just watch... Heh heh heh... The Bunker has an ace in the hole too.
Hmph, I hate tedious schemes. ...We lure them out and finish them fast.
Oh, do you have some plan? ...Let's see what you can do...
...with your Tenku Chushin Ken.
(?? ...Tenku Chushin Ken? What the... Things're gettin' messy, but...
that sure saved my hide, no lie.)
So... you have awakened...
Go... Take your revenge...
Yes, sir. ...For giving me another chance...
I thank you, Grand Captain Garimos...!
(Heh... Heh heh heh... Yes, another chance has come...
Next time for sure... Mia Alice...!)
Kyosuke Nanbu and Rain Mikamura... reporting in.
The Alteisen and Shining Gundam have been loaded aboard as well.
Good. You both made it safely... Glad the enemy didn't attack you.
Yes, the enemy's ground forces have weakened. The launch went fine.
Sounds like a lot happened on the ground. Rain, how's my brother?
He still needs rest, but he's doing well. ...He sends his regards, Domon.
...I see.
Thank you for your hard work... everyone.
Good work.
Ms. Purpleton... Hm, you're Amuro's...
Yes. I've been assisting the Captain...
I'd like a moment of your time about that later.
Very well. We'll make time during resupply.
Guess when you're someone like Amuro, the girls come flocking, huh?
Oh my, jealous, Judau?
But Judau, you've got me!
...How stupid.
Me, I'd rather have someone more active.
What, so a guy like Fujiwara's your type?
No thanks, not someone that stubborn!
Enough of this nonsense. ...I'm going ahead to start tuning.
Oh, I'm coming too! Wait up, Domon!
Rain, aren't you gonna chase after him? Allenby'll have him all to herself.
Y-Yes... I have to contact the Neo Japan colony
about Kyoji...
She just came up from the surface, and she's already working hard.
Come to think of it, what's Dr. Tarsan up to?
Who knows... We haven't heard from him lately...
Knowing that doctor, he's probably hiding somewhere
keeping an eye on things, right?
Drill, don't say such rude things!
It's fine, it's fine. I'm sure Drill's right.
Oh...? So you're the mechanical life-form aliens... Hmm...
If you like, would you come by my lab later?
Ms. Purpleton, they are our allies.
Please try not to be rude...
But if I could analyze them and feed it back into mobile suits...
This is hopeless.
Rom, you'd better get away before she catches you.
Understood. Then we'll be on the deck.
Jet, Drill, let's train while we have time.
Sis, let's go too.
Yes, let's watch Rom Stol and the others train...
Master Rom, please don't leave me behind!
Nina Purpleton. Sorry to interrupt, but...
Oh? ...You're... Kyosuke Nanbu, aren't you?
Yes. I have a favor to ask.
Oh? What is it?
This is...
The Captain designed it... the Nu Gundam.
I'd heard about it... Looks like it made it in time for combat.
Nina always says how frustrated she is.
She says she's never seen such a beautiful Gundam.
It certainly is a beautiful machine... But why frustrated?
She pours her heart and soul into Gundam design, so...
The combat equipment is almost finished.
We're about to start the activation checks.
...What are those plates on its back? For heat sinks,
they look awfully complex...
Those are Fin Funnels. Testing's done; all that's left is installing them.
Funnels? So it's... a Newtype-only machine.
...I hadn't heard the Federation had technology that advanced...
We built it using information from the materials development division.
You know the psycoframe, right?
It's built into the frame around the cockpit.
Built into the frame? Directly...? That's an amazing idea.
But... there's something strange.
Something... strange?
Yes... The claim that this idea came from Anaheim's materials division...
seems to be a lie.
A lie? Then... who?
I don't know... But in testing, it worked perfectly.
...That's troubling... The very fact that it works properly
suggests there may be something behind it...
Oh, Captain, you're here too? I heard there's a new model
being sent to Amuro? ...Whoa, so this is it.
Isn't it bigger than the Double Zeta?
Yes. For a standard mobile suit, it ended up on the large side.
Maybe it was designed with the opposite philosophy from the F91.
You two's mobile suits are kinda on the small side, huh?
Anyway, once this reaches Amuro... Captain Amuro, I can rest easy.
...Captain Quattro seemed interested in it too...
...Captain Quattro?
Yes... He said he was curious as a pilot... Is something wrong?
No... it's nothing. But getting it to the surface now isn't realistic.
...No. And it hasn't undergone gravity testing yet...
What if we use it?
Yes, that's the only option. Chan, do you mind?
It's fine... It was meant to be delivered to Londo Bell anyway,
so the paperwork doesn't change.
(Amuro... please come back soon...)
Complete... Heh heh heh... At last the true Rafflesia Project can begin...
Iron Mask.
Zabine Chareux, is it... What do you want?
...I want to ask about the code name "Bug."
...You'll see. Hm, Federation troops coming here? Perfect... Heh heh heh.
(...What are you plotting, Iron Mask...?)
A custom Gespenst Type 3... This is the first time I've seen one.
A crazy-powerful booster, live-ammo arms that ignore body balance...
It truly is the black sheep of a masterpiece Personal Trooper.
...Could custom parts from the Mk-II be used on this thing?
...The Gespenst Mk-II Custom... Come to think of it, one was assigned
to Londo Bell, wasn't it...
Actually, when I asked Captain Bright about upgrading the Alteisen,
he said to talk to you directly... Here's the upgrade plan I came up with.
An upgrade plan? Let me see... Huh, you can draft blueprints?
Yes. I'd been thinking about it for a while... It just took me a long time.
Uh-huh, I see...
...I need it upgraded, no matter what. Otherwise...
when I fight that thing, I'll lose out in a head-on clash...
Extra armor and stabilizers... And this cylinder on the arm?
It's bigger than the one on the current Revolving Stake...
The Riese type... the very first part built for the Stake.
I heard it was too big to balance, so they switched to the current type...
Riese... German for "giant." I see. ...And where's the part itself?
...It was tossed into a spare-parts container...
so it should have been brought here.
Got it. If it's just assembly using existing parts, it shouldn't take long.
We also have the ZZ's reinforced armor to fit, though...
...Please do.
...Say, this is a bit of a side job, but can I rig something into the Stake?
Rig something? I don't mind... but what is it?
I want to test a field-nullifying system Anaheim developed in-house.
Can't let Nergal beat us, after all. Well? Not a bad deal, right?
No... if anything, it helps.
Everyone at Anaheim, me included, will be pulling an all-nighter, though.
I'll send the bill to Bright.
...Sorry for being so selfish...
(If this works... I should be able to go toe-to-toe with it...
I'll defeat that Weissritter... and her...!)
Soon... it... will be...
Your... role... too... will... end...
...Kyosuke...
Captain, this is bad!
What is it, Mikamura?
The Neo Japan colony... is being attacked by the Einst!
They're requesting reinforcements immediately...
What...? What's going on...?
Captain Bright, is something wrong?
Yes... That enemy's signature appeared somewhere else as well.
...Right near the Moon.
They appeared at the same time!?
That's never happened before... Don't tell me... Excellen...!?
Hmm... But we can't ignore either one. ...Where's Domon?
Going wild on deck with Allenby and Rom's group. Calls it training.
Yeah, they were getting in the mechanics' way.
Looked like fun! Maybe I'll join in too!
When those guys go wild together... nobody can get near them...
We can tell them later. Looks like we'd better launch right away.
Right. All ships, prepare to launch! Everyone, stay on alert.
Hold on...! A transmission's coming in on a weird channel. I'll put it through.
A weird channel...? Oh, it's the Doc!
Oho, you lot!
And Captain Bright, was it? I've got vital information!
Vital information...?
You here to peddle more shady junk again?
Fool! It's information on the Bunker and the Gyandlar!
Truth is, they were chasing me until just a moment ago.
Whoa! ...So, are you okay?
Heh heh heh, with my technology, shaking them off is child's play.
So you're good at running away?
Call it a keen eye for opportunity.
...Or so I'd like to say, but I was rescued.
By who!?
Tenku Chushin Ken... the son of Kirai Stol.
Rom and the others!? But they were on the deck just now...
What happened? Rom and the others just rushed out.
Rushed out?
Yeah... they got some kind of transmission, and...
their faces changed color. Something like "That one I'll never forgive."
(Their faces can change color?)
And where are they now!?
Well... they went straight after the Gyandlar bunch that attacked me,
and off they went. ...Hmmm.
Doctor? Is something bothering you? And are you all right!?
I'm fine. ...Besides, I suspect their real target wasn't me...
It seems more like they wanted to lure out Rom Stol and his comrades.
The Gyandlar... I see.
After I shook them off, I checked where they went back to...
and they entered one of Earth's space colonies.
An Earth colony?
...With the war dragging on, lots of colonies
have ended up empty.
Maybe they're turning one of them into a hideout?
Dr. Tarsan, where is this colony?
Mm, I'm sending the data now... Right here.
...This is... the Texas Colony?
Captain, you know the place?
It was a lively tourist colony once, apparently...
but it was abandoned around the time of the One Year War.
Just like Judau said.
So we can play there for free?
...With the Gyandlar, right now.
It'd be trouble if they made it a forward base. ...We should crush it.
Way to go, Doc! Nice work, nice work!
Mm-hm. ...Hey, don't tease an old man.
Anyway, I've told you. I'll vanish before my pursuers show up.
You lot take care of yourselves.
We will. Be careful, Doctor...
The Neo Japan colony, the lunar vicinity... and now the Texas Colony.
...Things are getting hectic. Prepare to launch, anyway. As for Rom...
No need to worry about them so much, right? They'll catch up eventually.
It's not that simple...
He's not one to fall behind easily.
...Not to side with Allenby, but worrying won't get us anywhere.
Yeah, that's true. If anything, the problem is us, right?
A combined Bunker and Gyandlar army... They're bound to be tough...
Why're you getting cold feet!? We can't just leave 'em be, can we?
True... but it's eerie that the mystery enemy is active at the same time.
And the Crossbone Vanguard haven't made a single move lately...
(The Moon... and the Neo Japan colony... Most likely, at one of them,
Excellen will be there too... Just wait. This time for sure...!)
